svg.text: time, ms (0 — start of the click)

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Top: the original signal — a quiet 1 kHz tone and a sharp click. Below: the coding error (decoded − original, different scale).

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Error that appears already before the click (in the shaded area) is pre-echo: the quantization noise spreads over the whole transform window.
